counties.role: Historical district reference; cannot replace primary city hierarchy or claim current precise district boundaries.

knownLimitations: Approximate region from source data, not a survey-grade or current legal boundary.
2017 district boundaries include later split/merged units; repaired against exact source identities, never nearest centres.
Source geometries can disagree at boundaries/coasts; incompatible district parents never override a city match.

New cities or reclaimed land may be uncovered. A city-layer gap may use an actual historic county polygon hit only when explicit parent names/codes match the bundled city registry; records label this fallback as 2017 geoBoundaries. No nearest-centre or online fallback.
